intro: The Hallowed Rune is an inscribed stone passed to novice priests beginning their training in Coldridge Valley. Sent by the dwarven priest trainer Branstock Khalder, it calls aspiring wielders of the Holy Light into Anvilmar to begin their formal tutelage.

p: When a fledgling priest demonstrates their resolve aiding the mountaineers and defenders of Coldridge Valley, Branstock Khalder sends forth the Hallowed Rune. Inscribed with teachings of the Holy Light, the stone serves as both an introduction and an invitation. Dwarven novices are directed to step away from minor skirmishes in the snow and report to Anvilmar, where Branstock prepares them to mend wounds and harness holy power against the trogg infestation threatening Dun Morogh.
